question: An item is marked at ₹8,000. Two successive discounts of 10% and 15% are allowed. Find the equivalent single discount rate.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equivalent single discount for successive discounts a% and b% = [a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100]%

⇒ Equivalent Discount = 10 + 15 − (10 × 15) ÷ 100

⇒ Equivalent Discount = 25 − 1.5 = 23.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 23.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹8,000

Successive discounts = 10% and 15%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − D₁)/100 × (100 − D₂)/100

Equivalent Discount % = (Total Discount ÷ MP) × 100
